description: Call remote command to start the application, test the application for start-up while tab log

option.name: Start Command
option.help: Shell command required to start application

option.name: Close TTY
option.help: Closes the standard input output, and this option needs to be enabled for applications that exit after startup due to the exit of the parent process

option.name: Service Address
option.help: URL or IP:PORT, several commas separated, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080,127.0.0.1:8090

option.name: Start successful string
option.help: If log encoding is not UTF-8, configure: {GBK} Start complete; leave as little as possible and replace it with a service address detection

option.name: Timeout (seconds)
option.help: Starts the timeout in seconds, the timeout starts without success

option.name: Start Backup Command
option.help: Apply startup and execute this command after successful startup

option.name: Termination of start-up command
option.help: Use when Ctrl+C is required after certain start commands have been successfully activated

argument.name: Log Path
argument.help: Log path, which supports wildcards and inverts to display the startup log after the startup command
